snippet.title: Yomegami - My Sweet Goddess - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Published by JAST USA
Developed by ALcot
Release Date Summer 2025

The human realm is peaceful today.
They are unaware of the existence of miracles.
They are even more oblivious to the war among the gods in the divine realm.
The story takes place in the year 20XX in autumn.

Hibiki Narukawa, the reincarnation of the demon who once caused havoc in the divine realm, arrives in the city of Masaireshin.
Hibiki's mother, the goddess of rebirth, Alice, tells her son:
"Accumulate good deeds in the human realm to atone for the sins of your past life.
By doing so, you can return to the divine realm."
Following his mother's teachings, Hibiki grows up to be a young man of upright character, seriousness, and diligence.
However, the curse of the demon brings hardships to Hibiki.
